title: Raw archive event
description: Every event the SIEM manager archived, before any OCSF remap: the raw-archive table of the soc namespace, which the source census reads to judge each log source against its own cadence. Not an OCSF class (class uid 0: the platform's own, in these conventions).

uid.description: Stable content-derived event id; the idempotency (content) key.

time.description: The manager's event timestamp, RFC 3339 with an explicit offset; stored as UTC.

location.description: The log source's location as the manager records it (a file, a journal unit, an agent module): with decoder_name, the census's source key.

tlp.description: The row's TLP 2.0 label (ADR-0033 decision 5), set from the event's labels.hnx_tlp by the log pipeline; the lake refuses a row without one. Not an OCSF attribute.

route.description: The log pipeline's route the event arrived on (its dataset, the TLP declaration's key).

source_kind.description: The kind of source the pipeline judged the event to be (the remap it took).

raw.description: The whole event as the pipeline received it (JSON, labels removed), cut at 64 KiB.
